title: Sociedad e identidad
goal: Read about the region's demographic transformation into the developing world's most urbanized region by 2000 -- rising urban population, sprawling megacities, and informal settlements.

items: Describe the region's deepest demographic transformation by 2000.
State the region's urban population share in 2000 versus mid-century.
Name three cities that became major metropolitan areas.
Explain what accelerated urban growth produced on city outskirts.
Use hasta el punto de que to introduce an extreme consequence.
